release_notes: Fix for 1.6.0 — update as usual, no extra steps. On servers where the 1.6.0 root setup (cli/server_setup.sh) had been run, the Domains page falsely warned that certbot was not installed and the manual "Issue SSL" button was blocked: the panel still checked the old blanket certbot sudo rule that 1.6.0 deliberately removed. It now checks the orbitra-issue-cert helper the issuer actually uses, and a real sudo problem gets its own message with the one command that fixes it. Background certificate issuance was never affected.
